lines: {target}? Gentle ground can make travelers careless. I would save bread for the road home.
If anyone heads for Meadow, tell them: Rest there, but do not forget night comes. I will be at the fields.
Flowers and bees do not bar the dark. I will remember that when I put bread aside.
Meadow is no small story. A full belly is not the same as safety.
I will remember Meadow as soft grass that still needs a lantern. I will keep bread aside for the road.
